name: images-nasa
description: NASA Image and Video Library (images.nasa.gov): search NASA's public image, video and audio archive, browse albums and the popular/recent feeds, and get asset files, technical metadata and video captions for any item.

commands.name: search-media
commands.summary: Search NASA images, videos and audio by free text, keyword tags, NASA center, media type and year range (paged, 100 per page by default)

params.name: media_type
params.description: Comma-separated media types to include: image, video, audio (e.g. 'image,video')

params.name: keywords
params.description: Keyword tag(s) to match, comma-separated (e.g. 'LUNAR SURFACE')

params.name: center
params.description: NASA center code that published the media, e.g. HQ, KSC, JSC, GSFC, JPL, LRC, MSFC, ARC

params.name: title
params.description: Match terms in the title only

params.name: description
params.description: Match terms in the description only

commands.name: get-asset
commands.summary: List the downloadable file URLs (original, large, medium, small, thumb; video encodings, captions, metadata) for a NASA media item

commands.name: get-metadata
commands.summary: Get the full technical and descriptive metadata (EXIF/QuickTime/AVAIL fields: dates, dimensions, duration, keywords, credits) of a NASA media item

commands.name: get-metadata-location
commands.summary: Resolve the URL of a media item's metadata.json via the official API (use when you don't know the item's media type)

commands.name: get-video-captions
commands.summary: Get the SRT caption/subtitle transcript of a NASA video

params.name: nasa_id
params.description: NASA video ID (the caption file is named after it)

commands.name: get-album
commands.summary: List the media items in a named NASA album (e.g. Apollo), paged

params.name: album_name
params.description: Album name as it appears in /album/{name} URLs; case-sensitive

commands.name: list-popular
commands.summary: List currently trending/popular media items shown on the home page

commands.name: list-recent
commands.summary: List the newest uploads to the NASA Image and Video Library

notes: No login or API key is needed. Everything is public and read-only.
Item IDs are nasa_id values, found in search results at items[].data[0].nasa_id. They can contain spaces and punctuation, which must be URL-encoded in paths.
The human-readable page for an item is https://images.nasa.gov/details/{nasa_id}.
search-media needs at least one search parameter (q, keywords, center, nasa_id, title, etc.).
In search-media, media_type takes a comma-separated list, for example 'image,video,audio'.
Search pages hold 100 items by default. The total hit count is in collection.metadata.total_hits of the raw response, and a 'next' link appears in collection.links.
get-asset returns file URLs such as ~orig.jpg/.tif, ~large.jpg, ~medium.jpg, ~small.jpg and ~thumb.jpg. Videos also have .mp4 encodings plus .srt and metadata.json files.
The same file list is available at https://images-assets.nasa.gov/{media_type}/{nasa_id}/collection.json.
get-metadata needs the item's media_type, which is data[0].media_type in search results. If you don't know it, call get-metadata-location, which returns the exact metadata.json URL.
Captions exist only for some videos. get-video-captions returns an error for videos without an .srt file.
